description: Get current Ethereum or Base gas price (wei & gwei) via one eth_gasPrice JSON-RPC call; live values may change between calls. For chain, use exactly ethereum or base (case-sensitive). USE WHEN: getting gas price for fee estimation or tx prep. DO NOT USE WHEN: inspecting existing transactions, checking wallet balances, estimating total tx cost, submitting transactions, or making execution decisions.
